guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
The Dockerfile build failed due to a CondaToSNonInteractiveError. The issue lies in the Miniconda configuration: terms of service for certain channels (https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main and https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/r) have not been accepted. This error occurs when using the default non-interactive mode during Docker builds. To fix this issue, add the following commands after setting up Miniconda to explicitly accept the terms of service for these channels:

```
RUN /opt/miniconda3/bin/conda tos accept --override-channels --channel https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main
RUN /opt/miniconda3/bin/conda tos accept --override-channels --channel https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/r
```

These commands should be placed before creating and activating the 'testbed' Conda environment. This change will ensure that the terms of service are accepted and will allow the Dockerfile to build successfully.
